name: code-craft
description: Language- and framework-specific code best practices and idioms for Claude Code — complementary to compass (stack-agnostic architecture coach). Two modes: reader (rule + reason + example for a topic) and reviewer (apply rules to user code, flag violations with fixes). Ships rules for TypeScript, Rust, CSS/SASS, Tailwind, Dart, Go, Python and frameworks React, Next.js, RN+Expo, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Astro, Svelte, Drizzle, Supabase, AWS Lambda+SAM, Terraform, Flutter.
